text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki and I are on our way home after a day out when she stops in front of an old book store.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer, would it be okay if we took a slight detour?
choice_data_list: Oh, want to do some shopping?
Oh, want to do some shopping?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. This store has an old book I've been wanting to buy for some time. I've been saving up to buy it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's a book that documents the physical training methods of various jujitsu schools, as well as techniques of schools whose lineages have come to an end. It's an extremely valuable record.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The mere thought of those lost techniques… I can't wait to see how much I can learn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wait for Yaeno Muteki in front of the shop. Soon, however…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's gone! The book is nowhere in sight! I'm certain it was there just the other day!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, shopkeeper! The valuable book that was on the back shelf—has it been sold?!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh yes, a girl came and bought that book just a few moments ago.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: In fact, you two were wearing the same uniform. What school is that again?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A student from Tracen Academy?! And if she recently bought the book, she must still be nearby!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'd like to peruse a few of its pages at the very least… Let's chase after her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I got some great shopping done! ♪ …All right, this looks like a solid reading spot.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's Ryan! And look! She's holding a bag from the store!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I always thought Ryan specialized in modern training methods, but to think she holds an interest in traditional techniques as well…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ryan! I have a life-or-death request!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Yaeno? What's got you looking so desperate?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That book you just purchased… Would it be possible for me to take a look at it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Y-you mean this?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I had no idea that you were also interested in this subject matter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec… Are you saying… you, uh, want to read this book too?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It would be more accurate to say that, considering the path I've walked, it would be a failure for me not to read it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Suddenly, I want to know all about your past!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'd be eternally grateful if you'd let me join you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: O-okay, okay! I get it! I'll show you the book, so just take it easy!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You have my deepest gratitude! I will remember your selfless gesture for the rest of my life!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Wh-what is this book? On the very first page we turn to… c-c-canoodling?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Don't say that out loud! Even for a romance comic… this one's got a load of—ahem—bold scenes!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Wh-what is the meaning of this? I thought this book covered traditional training methods!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh… Th-they're holding hands, and… they're even doing that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa, shhh! Keep it down!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! Nooooo…
choice_data_list: Those are some interesting traditional training methods.
So where's the actual book you were looking for?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No! This is definitely the wrong book!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Th-this… was all a misunderstanding on my part. But how?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! I'm such a fool! We're all fooools!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …It turns out that the shopkeeper had just moved the book in question when reorganizing the shelves.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, indeed… Where in the world could it be?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes… Right away. Um, apologies, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: H-hey?! Hold on a sec! You're just going to take off after embarrassing me like that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …It turns out that the shopkeeper had just moved the book in question when reorganizing the shelves.
